title: Open New Savings Sub-Account
description: Opens a new savings sub-account for an existing member and funds it with an opening deposit, driving the workflow through to the confirmation screen.
goal: Open a new sub-account of type {account_type} for member {member_number}, with an opening deposit of {opening_deposit}, and reach the confirmation screen.

inputs.name: member_number
inputs.description: The member number for whom the sub-account is being opened.

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: The type of sub-account to open.

inputs.name: opening_deposit
inputs.description: The amount to deposit into the new sub-account at opening.

outputs.name: confirmation_reference
outputs.description: The confirmation or transaction reference number shown on the confirmation screen.

outputs.name: opening_balance
outputs.description: The confirmed opening balance of the new sub-account after the deposit.

outcomes.description: No member exists with the given member number.
The member is not eligible to open a new sub-account (e.g. account restricted, suspended, or closed).
outcomes.signal_text: Member is not eligible for a new sub-account

outcomes.description: The opening deposit does not meet the minimum required amount or is otherwise invalid for the chosen account type.
outcomes.signal_text: Opening deposit does not meet minimum requirement

outcomes.description: The selected account type is not available for this member or product set.
outcomes.signal_text: Selected account type is not available

outcomes.description: The funding source for the opening deposit does not have sufficient funds.
outcomes.signal_text: Insufficient funds to complete opening deposit

outcomes.description: A sub-account of this type was already recently opened or is pending for this member.
outcomes.signal_text: A similar sub-account request is already pending or exists
